status: Design fixed after linear-boundary attribution; implementation and all candidate kernels have not started.
hypothesis: Initializing the matrix-product destination with row-broadcast bias and calling the existing pure-Rust gemm with destination accumulation removes some discrepancy caused by separate bias rounding, without introducing an OS-specific BLAS dependency. This does not guarantee identity with Accelerate or fix the distinct small-row matmul discrepancy.
candidate: One finite float32 fused_linear public backend extension for Flex and Autodiff, sharing the existing extension boundary. Same gemm0.19.0 and current strides/orientation/parallelism=None, read_dst=true and destination coefficient1/product coefficient1; initialized output contains bias for each row. Public high-rank wrapper flattens inputs exactly as current SmallForecaster. No scalar dot-order alternatives, padding/augmented matrices, f64 matmul, alternate kernels, packing threshold changes or vendor FFI.
dependency: If direct gemm access is needed, add only optional gemm=0.19.0/default-features=false, enabled by a nondefault fused-linear-extension feature that also enables the existing fma-extension. Existing transitive features remain in effect; no new SIMD/rayon/BLAS feature, version, package or download. Snapshot Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock before the one offline lock refresh; require changes limited to the banto-ai root dependency edge and the identical active package/version set. Preserve original lock bytes in a fresh declaration. Do not edit the registry.
safety: Metadata validation is a safe API: float32 only, same device/autodiff/checkpoint context, x[m,k], weight[k,n], bias[n], m1..120/k1..128/n1..128, nonempty. Preserve current logical/physical strided weight layout; do not make weights contiguous as a hidden candidate. Any public gemm unsafe pointer call must be isolated in a Flex primitive helper with explicit checked allocation sizes, offset+stride bounds for all reads, supported nonnegative strides, separate output allocation, no aliasing, and a written safety proof. No unsafe representation conversion, private bridge or high-level to_data/from_data reinjection. Kernel rejects nonfinite inputs/output. If public layout/storage APIs cannot support the proof, stop before a kernel.
autodiff: Retain x/weight/bias parent guards until node finish. Compile mathematical dx=dY@weight.T, dW=x.T@dY, db=sum_rows(dY) through existing backend ops; graph participation is checked independently. No backward execution or gradient correctness claim before R2 acceptance design. Do not detach or silently discard parents.
finite_artificial: Eight fixed small cases: ordinary exact integer product, zero input/nonzero bias, zero weight/nonzero bias, mixed-sign integer cancellation, row-broadcast bias, transposed weight view, row-offset input view, exactly representable dyadic fractions. Plain/Autodiff must match independently specified exact outputs, preserve input and graph, and reject incompatible shape/dtype/context/nonfinite/oversize. Freeze actual fixture values and expected bits in a fresh declaration before first Rust kernel. No fixture changes based on numeric results.
finite_local: After artificial pass, one candidate-only evaluation of all154 saved linear PP operands (patch7, attention_projection84, attention_output_projection28, ff_linear28, head7); use the existing closed PP outputs and RP baseline outputs, do not rerun the old baseline or the55-node full audit. Require all candidate outputs finite and within unchanged R0 normalized tolerance, aggregate SSE strictly smaller than saved RP, each case's aggregate SSE nonincreasing. Report patch train and artificial cases separately; no result-selected layers/shapes or case-specific switch.
finite_full: Only after all local gates: one uniform hook for all linear modules, with independently verified source-order context and LayerNorm, existing3tests, one original7-case/23-anchor/389214-element forward/comparison. Same weights/inputs/reference/R0.1 tolerances. One candidate, no retry after a scientific failure. No CARE test/demand2015 reevaluation or training.
decision: If entire R1 passes, adopt through an explicit default feature and verify the existing3tests under that feature selection once; legacy remains accessible without default features. If a scientific gate fails, restore model.rs exact pre-candidate bytes and retain only opt-in primitive sources/results/negative evidence. Do not declare R1/R2 or product acceptance from local pass.
